text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин conquers the Satsuki Sho,
the first
race of the Classic Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Drawing the eyes of the entire
racecourse, she
proudly declares that
the track is where she
belongs.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the stands is a young, redheaded girl
who is
moved to tears by her incredible
run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит, having lost the race,
firmly vows
to win the next race—the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
